title: Shared: Test vectors for synchronized hopping
description:
Create authoritative test vectors for GNSS-synchronized frequency hopping.

## File
test/vectors/sync_hop.json

## Required Vector Coverage
- **SFN derivation**: Various unix timestamps -> expected SFN values
- **Channel calculation**: (sfn, seed, n_channels) -> expected channel
- **Edge cases**: SFN wrap, boundary conditions, minimum channels
- **Fallback scenarios**: GNSS unavailable -> epoch-based fallback

## Format
```json
{
  "sfn_derivation": [
    {"unix_time_ms": 1704067200000, "superframe_ms": 100, "epoch_base_ms": 1704067200000, "expected_sfn": 0},
    ...
  ],
  "channel_selection": [
    {"sfn": 0, "seed": 0, "n_channels": 8, "expected_channel": <n>},
    ...
  ]
}
```

## Oracle Requirement
Vectors MUST be computed using independent FNV-1a32 implementation (not LICHEN code) as oracle.

## Blocks
All implementation tasks depend on these vectors.
close_reason: Created test/vectors/sync_hop.json with 22 test vectors covering: SFN derivation (8 vectors), channel selection (10 vectors), SFN wrap edge cases (3 vectors), sequence consistency (1 vector). Oracle: independent FNV-1a32 implementation, verified against LICHEN code. All vectors pass.
